brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: 4× Hex base · Full at (0,0,0), (1,0,0) forming pair 1 and (0,1,0), (1,1,0) forming pair 2 – visible as 2×2 block of 4 bases

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other joining hardware)
requirements.evidence: All inter-cell seams bridged with side connectors only: connector:0#0,0|1,0 (bottom pair), connector:0#0,1|1,1 (top pair), plus connector:0#0,0|0,1 and connector:0#1,0|1,1 joining the two pairs to each other. No other family used between bases; caps and single jointBolt are house-rule closures, not pair-to-pair joiners. meshClash clear, check_build ok

finish.summary: Built 2×2 arrangement of 4 full bases as two horizontal pairs (y=0 and y=1). Each pair internally linked by a side connector, and the two pairs linked to each other by two vertical side connectors – all seams use only side connectors, verified with caps and locked joints and mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
